{{recipe}}

{{Recipe summary
| Category = Condiment recipes
| Yield = 1⅓ cups (about 315 ml)
| Time = 10 minutes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] clove
*6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (160 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) pitted Kalamata [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]]
*⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (80 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] white [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*⅓ cup (80 ml) chopped [[Cookbook:Red onion|red onions]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (30 ml) capers, rinsed and drained
*1 tbsp (15 ml) grated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] peel
*1 tbsp (15 ml) fresh [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] leaves
*¼ cup (60 ml) [[Cookbook:Olive oil|olive oil]]
*Toasted baguette or rustic [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] slices

==Procedure==

# In [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] with motor running, drop in garlic and chop. Turn off motor and add olives, onions, capers, lemon peel and thyme. Pulse to chop to coarse consistency.
# Add olive oil and pulse to just blend keeping texture in mixture.
# Serve with toasted baguette or rustic bread slices.
